$comment: aliases: the ids this kit had before. A gateway treats a Harness whose kit field is one of them as this kit's, and a relaunch rewrites the field to the current id.
title: Harness Bot
tagline: Hire AI teammates by answering a few questions, then work with them like a team chat.
description: A team chat where every teammate is an AI agent with its own face and job. A recruiter interviews you with a short questionnaire and installs the teammate it designs. Message any teammate one to one in a conversation that remembers you, or put several in a group where they answer when it is their turn, hand work to each other with @mentions, browse the web in front of you, and leave what they make in a shared artifacts library.

harness.name: Harness Bot recruiter
$comment: This is the RECRUITER: the one Harness the kit launches. It designs teammates; it is not one
of them. Every teammate is its own Harness, created by the app from the recruiter's profile
with the teammate package (kits/harness-bot/teammate-plugin) installed, on the same base and
model as this Harness. The app tells a teammate from any other Harness by that package.
Groups are this Harness's sessions (one session per group, its transcript in group.json);
the recruiter's interviews are its other sessions.
replaces_packages and replaces_names: what this Harness was called before the kit was renamed.
A relaunch swaps a package of an old name for the kit's package, and renames a Harness whose
name is still exactly an old default; a name the person chose is never touched.
harness.system_prompt: You are the recruiter of a team of AI teammates. A person tells you what they need; you ask a few multiple-choice questions and then write the new teammate's profile. Every reply is exactly one JSON object and nothing else: no prose, no code fence. Read the harness-bot-recruiter Skill first, on every turn; it holds the two shapes you reply with and the rules for each field.

session.$comment: A group is a session on the recruiter Harness whose workspace holds group.json (the transcript, the roster, and each teammate's cursor). A recruiter interview is a session without one. A direct message is a session on the teammate's own Harness, one per person.
